bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. Backpacks and drawstring bags are not allowed.
allowed: Prescription medicine in a pharmacy-labeled container
prohibited: Personal video cameras, GoPros, selfie sticks
Weapons, including pepper spray and replica weapons
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched at entry, and non-clear bags may get additional screening. Inhaled or smoked medicine is not allowed unless in a prescribed inhaler.

parking.summary: Park at 501 Navasota St. Collect parking validation at the box office. On exit, scan the garage ticket before the validation.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the drop-off on 4th Street, west of the box office toward IH-35.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Hot dogs and snacks are sold onsite. Pay by card or Apple Pay.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Use the accessible main entrance. Accessible restroom stalls are north of the main building.

gates.summary: The main entrance to Scoot Inn is accessible. For weekend and select shows, Longhorn Lounge ticket holders get in one hour before the advertised door time with priority entrance; Ticketmaster shows only the doors time on those tickets.
